note: EDA showed near-zero correlation between every feature and the purchase label in this dataset (all feature-level purchase rates cluster around the ~5% base rate). ROC-AUC close to 0.5 here is the expected, honest result of that -- it confirms the model isn't finding a real relationship because the dataset largely does not contain one, not because of a modeling error. Accuracy alone would look artificially high (~95%) simply by predicting the majority class -- that's why precision/recall/F1/ROC-AUC are reported alongside it.
